description: restore_snapshot rejects a snapshot payload carrying the same struct field twice. Uses request_raw because a serde_json::Value round-trip collapses duplicate keys, which is the behavior under test. Before HEU-743 the handler routed params through a Value and this restored, keeping the last value. Protocol 8 carries the change. Pairs with restore_snapshot_undeserializable and restore_snapshot_inconsistent: three ways a restore can fail, and they must not all answer with the same code. The duplicate sits on Arena.nodes rather than on the snapshot's top level so that a new required field on Arena cannot turn this into a missing-field failure instead of the rejection it tests. Renaming Arena.nodes still would.
